svg.title: The double iframe, and the postMessage channel through it
svg.desc: Three regions nested inside one another on the left. The outermost, outlined in blue, is the host page on origin A, which owns the model, the conversation and the consent decision. Inside it, drawn with a dashed outline, is the sandbox proxy iframe on origin B, which must differ from the host, carrying the sandbox attribute allow-scripts and allow-same-origin, and forwarding every message in both directions except the reserved sandbox notifications. Inside that, outlined in terracotta, is the view iframe holding the server HTML from the ui:// resource, under a Content Security Policy built from _meta.ui.csp, with a note that an omitted policy means the host applies its own deny-by-default one and that _meta.ui.permissions becomes the iframe allow attribute. On the right, five numbered steps give the startup order: the sandbox announces itself with sandbox-proxy-ready; the host answers with sandbox-resource-ready carrying the raw HTML; the view sends ui/initialize with its capabilities and client info, and the host replies with a protocolVersion of 2026-01-26, which is the Apps version rather than the core one; the view sends the initialized notification, and until it arrives the host must not send the view any request or notification; and only then may the host push tool-input and tool-result, with ordinary tools/call requests coming back from the view for the host to proxy, block or ask about. A footer lists what the nesting denies the view, the parent document tree, the host cookies and storage, parent navigation and script in the parent context, and notes that ui/initialize is not MCP's initialize, which was removed in revision 2026-07-28.
svg.text: Two frames, because one would not be a sandbox
The middle frame exists so the host and the view never share an origin.
Host page
origin A. Owns the model, the conversation, and the consent.
Sandbox proxy iframe
origin B, which MUST differ from the host
sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"
Forwards every message that is not a reserved
ui/notifications/sandbox- message, both ways.
View iframe
the server's HTML, from the ui:// resource
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none';
script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; ...
Built from _meta.ui.csp. Omitted means the host
applies its own deny-by-default policy instead.
_meta.ui.permissions becomes the allow attribute.
Startup order, and it is strict
ui/notifications/sandbox-proxy-ready
sandbox to host, once the frame is live
ui/notifications/sandbox-resource-ready
host to sandbox, carrying the raw HTML
ui/initialize
view to host: appCapabilities, clientInfo.
The reply carries protocolVersion "2026-01-26",
which is the Apps version, not the core one.
ui/notifications/initialized
view to host. Until this arrives the host MUST
NOT send the view any request or notification.
ui/notifications/tool-input, then tool-result
and later, an ordinary tools/call from the view,
which the host proxies, blocks, or asks about.
What the nesting denies: the parent document tree, the host cookies and storage, parent navigation, and script in the parent context.
ui/initialize is not MCP's initialize. That one was removed in 2026-07-28. This one rides on postMessage and is unaffected by it.
